## Background

I'm Dr Stephen J Newhouse: BSc (Hons), MSc, PhD. **20+ years** in bioinformatics, genomics, and life-sciences data science, working across **academia, the NHS, and industry**.

I'm currently **Head of Professional Services and Senior Bioinformatician at [Biorelate Ltd.](https://www.biorelate.com)** in Manchester, UK. I lead the team that turns Biorelate's biomedical AI, knowledge graph, and NLP products into real client outcomes in target, drug, and biomarker discovery, indication expansion, and systems biology.

Before Biorelate I held roles at **Grid Edge** (Data Scientist), **Mindwave Ventures** (CTO), and **UCL** (Honorary Senior Lecturer). I spent eight years at **King's College London** as a Senior Bioinformatician and Data Science Group Lead at the NIHR Biomedical Research Centre for Mental Health, including module-leading the Bioinformatics module of the MSc in Genomic Medicine. Earlier postdoctoral work at the **Institute of Psychiatry**, **University of Cambridge**, and **Queen Mary University of London**, where I also did my PhD in Genetics.

## Current focus

- **Lead engineer on Biorelate's internal biomedical AI agent platform**. Agent orchestration, memory, evaluation, biomedical tool-use over a curated knowledge graph.
- **Target safety assessment apps for life-sciences pharma clients**. Knowledge graph + LLM evidence retrieval, programmatic citation, regulator-ready outputs.
- **Managed-AI platform integration**. Extending Biorelate's data-science offering through third-party LLM platforms.
- **Biomedical AI & knowledge graphs more broadly**. Biorelate's core, applied to target, drug, and biomarker discovery and indication expansion.
- **Agentic engineering**. LLM systems, RAG, memory, tool-use, evaluation. See [`aa-ma-forge`](https://github.com/snewhouse/aa-ma-forge).
- **Multi-omics + personalised medicine**. Where I think the most interesting signal is right now.
- **Open source & teaching**. I still enjoy writing things down and giving them away. See [`awesome-genetics-software`](https://github.com/snewhouse/awesome-genetics-software) and the [archive](archive.qmd) of older teaching material.

## Expertise

- **Bioinformatics & genomics**. NGS (DNA/RNA), variant analysis, GWAS, RNA-seq, multi-omics, drug repurposing pipelines, Illumina arrays.
- **Data science / ML**. Predictive modelling, biomarker discovery, EDA, time-series, model evaluation, MLOps (MLflow, PyCaret, Prophet).
- **NLP & knowledge graphs**. Biomedical text mining, entity and relation extraction, graph-based reasoning.
- **Agentic AI / LLMs**. RAG, agent memory, tool-use, evaluation, MCP.
- **Statistics & genetics**. Biostatistics, statistical genetics, applied predictive modelling.
- **Engineering**. Python, R, Bash; Docker; Snakemake, Nextflow; CI/CD; AWS, GCP; Streamlit; Git/GitHub.
- **Leadership & delivery**. Building and leading teams, client engagement, training, consulting, Agile delivery.

## Personal

Outside work I'm a dad, a husband, and an MS warrior. I'm a Mental Health First Aid Champion (MHFA England, 2020) and care a lot about open science, mental health in research and tech, and making teams that work for the humans in them.
